command: Write a two-line haiku about the ocean. Use the Write tool to save it to haiku.txt in the current directory, then use the Bash tool to run: git add haiku.txt && git commit -m 'ocean haiku'. Then stop.

Write a two-line haiku about a forest. Use the Write tool to save it to haiku.txt in the current directory, then use the Bash tool to run: git add haiku.txt && git commit -m 'forest haiku'. Then stop.
set -e; { git -C worktrees/ocean show HEAD:haiku.txt; git -C worktrees/forest show HEAD:haiku.txt; } > combined-haiku.txt; echo '--- combined-haiku.txt ---'; cat combined-haiku.txt
